//! Writes a database holding a table that names a column after the row
//! identity, a view reading that column, and a table that does not
use stoolap::Database;

fn main() {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("an output directory");
    let db = Database::open(&format!("file://{out}/column_named_rowid_beside")).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, _rowid_ INTEGER)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE u (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, v INTEGER)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO u VALUES (1, 100)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT _rowid_ AS x FROM t", ()).unwrap();
    db.close().unwrap();
}
